symbols.behavior: Accept only unprefixed defs, symbol, marker, clipPath; empty element resolves to itself; otherwise first END_ELEMENT at the starting depth.
symbols.ownership_errors_limits: Borrows source and token slice; malformed spans and unsupported names return None; no allocation or source-size cap.

symbols.behavior: Preserves complete root, common, per-kind geometry, metadata, XML space, namespace, and foreign-attribute allowlist rules.
symbols.ownership_errors_limits: Borrows source/tokens; invalid element, span, or name fails closed.

symbols.behavior: Indexes unprefixed nonempty IDs with exact raw-byte equality and C's FNV-1a seed/multiplier; rejects duplicates and empty IDs; accepts at most 65536 IDs.
symbols.ownership_errors_limits: Index immutably borrows source/tokens; fixed 131072-entry u32 Vec, allocated only for nonempty IDs via try_reserve_exact. Actual capacity is checked before resize/fill/publication. A successful oversized candidate is dropped and maps to Limit; only reserve failure maps to OutOfMemory. Errors include source offsets; Result publishes no partial index.

symbols.behavior: Releases the fixed slot table, including on construction error.
symbols.ownership_errors_limits: Rust Vec ownership replaces manual destroy/free; failures return no index handle.

symbols.behavior: Linear-probes exact raw ID bytes; counts occupied probes and terminal empty probe with saturating usize arithmetic.
symbols.ownership_errors_limits: Query span must be in borrowed source; invalid/empty spans miss without indexing outside source.

symbols.behavior: Reports allocated Vec capacity times u32 size; empty index reports zero.
symbols.ownership_errors_limits: Checked multiplication; nonempty table is retained only when actual Vec capacity exactly equals the fixed slot capacity.

symbols.behavior: Only the first root start element's contiguous attributes can bind exact xmlns:xlink URI.
symbols.ownership_errors_limits: Invalid spans fail closed; no allocation or fetch.

symbols.behavior: Preserves the full use allowlist; prefixed attributes are only bound xlink:href.
symbols.ownership_errors_limits: Borrowed token/source; invalid spans, namespace, element, or attribute fail closed.

symbols.behavior: Exact source spans; same FNV constants; unprefixed ID attribute lookup; typed error category and byte offset.
symbols.ownership_errors_limits: Checked offset+length and safe slice lookup; no unsafe code or entity decoding.

safe_adaptations: base_bytes and pointer/count pairs become borrowed &[u8] and &[XmlToken]; null pointer states are unrepresentable.
shape errors used by this module are local ReferenceError variants None, InvalidArgument, Unsupported, Limit, OutOfMemory with byte offsets; unfinished shape crate is not imported.

Rust Vec::try_reserve_exact reports allocation failure; after success the actual capacity must equal 131072 before resize/fill. An oversized candidate is consumed and dropped with Limit, never retained and never misreported as allocator OOM. Storage reports actual retained capacity in bytes.
XML entity spellings remain raw source bytes in IDs. Distinct spellings such as a&b and a&b remain distinct keys, matching C byte-span behavior.
No 16 MiB source cap or external-resource resolution was introduced.
